verdict.rationale: Pomelo documents a risk-and-fraud-management section in which 3D Secure uses a risk score combined with configurable rules, such as forcing a challenge above an amount threshold even when risk is low. That gives it its own fraud scoring at authentication time for e-commerce. It also offers merchant, category and merchant-ID blocking as a protective control, but that is adjacent to blocking a compromised card rather than the same capability. Missing for 10: fraud scores or models applied to all card authorizations beyond 3DS, suspicious-activity alerting to ops, documented tooling to block and reissue compromised cards, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
